info.description: The Coupon Management API enables businesses to efficiently update existing coupons through their unique identifiers. This endpoint allows authorized users to replace the details of a coupon, ensuring that promotional offers remain current and effective. Typical consumers include e-commerce platforms and marketing teams seeking to manage customer discounts seamlessly. By utilizing this API, organizations can enhance their promotional strategies while maintaining accurate records of available offers.

put.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific coupon identified by its unique ID. Make sure to include all necessary information in the request body to successfully update the coupon.
